summary: The calls and offsets match, but the binary performs the flag calculation before clearing result[1].
issues: The P-code loads result[0] and applies the AND and OR before storing zero to result[1]. The reversed code stores zero first. The decompilation appears to have reordered these independent operations.
fix_instructions: Compute a temporary as (result[0] & 0xfffffbffu) | 0x400u immediately after FUN_006d8619, then set result[1] = 0, then assign the temporary to result[0].
